title: Ethereal Flaky Moroccan Sweet Potatoes Msemen
description: Cultured, flaky, and comforting, this Moroccan msemen is the perfect dish for a sick day, featuring sweet potatoes and a unique pandan-leaf wrap.
instructions: Peel the sweet potatoes and boil them in water until tender.
In a mortar, pound the garlic cloves until smooth.
Mix the flour, salt, and olive oil in a bowl to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes, then let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle using a rolling pin.
Brush the circles with ghee and sprinkle with date syrup.
Add a few pieces of boiled sweet potato to the center of each circle.
Fold the dough in a half-moon shape and seal the edges with a little water.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the msemen for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Serve the msemen hot, wrapped in a pandan leaf.
To make the pandan leaf wrap, simply cut the top of the pandan leaf and place it on a plate.
Place a piece of msemen in the center of the leaf and wrap it up.
Serve with a drizzle of date syrup and a sprinkle of rose water.
Optional: Garnish with additional rose petals and serve with a side of steamed vegetables.
